result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it harder for people to treat other humans as background noise.

Not every bad act. Not every difference. Just the habit of living as if my own discomfort, status, fear, or preferences are the main thing that matters while someone else’s pain is some abstract number off-screen.

I’d remove that default numbness.
